officialName: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
summary: Health insurance scheme providing coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

benefit.displayText: ₹5 lakh health insurance per family per year

eligibility.displayText: Must belong to vulnerable occupational categories (e.g., street vendor, domestic worker, construction worker, etc.) as per SECC 2011 data

applicationSteps: Check eligibility on the PMJAY portal (mera.pmjay.gov.in) using mobile number or ration card
If eligible, visit nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC)
Provide Aadhaar and ration card for e-KYC verification

sources.title: PMJAY Official Website
sources.publisher: National Health Authority, Govt of India
